title: Receive the life the Guru gives
summary: The True Guru plants the Lord in the heart and grants the life of the soul through the Ambrosial Naam. Let worth begin with received life, not self-measurement.
takeaway: Receive Naam as the life beneath your worth.
lifeApplication: Before asking the room to tell you who you are, sit with the breath and remember the Guru gives the soul its living center.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting the True Guru plants the Lord within the heart and gives the soul life through remembrance of the Ambrosial Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before asking the world who you are, remember the life of the soul is received, not performed.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru grants the life of the soul by placing remembrance of the Ambrosial Naam in the heart.
evidence.turn: Worth moves from self-measurement to received spiritual life.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before asking the room to tell you who you are, sit with the breath and remember the Guru gives the soul its living center.
